session.sql: MERGE items WITH(SERIALIZABLE) AS target USING (VALUES (1)) AS source(id) ON target.id=source.id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id) VALUES (source.id);

DELETE FROM dbo.items; MERGE items  AS target USING (VALUES (1)) AS source(id) ON target.id=source.id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id) VALUES (source.id);
DELETE FROM dbo.items; MERGE items WITH (HOLDLOCK, UPDLOCK, ROWLOCK) AS target USING (VALUES (1)) AS source(id) ON target.id=source.id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id) VALUES (source.id);
MERGE items WITH (NOLOCK) AS target USING (VALUES (1)) AS source(id) ON target.id=source.id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id) VALUES (source.id);
MERGE items WITH (bogus) AS target USING (VALUES (1)) AS source(id) ON target.id=source.id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id) VALUES (source.id);
MERGE items AS target WITH (HOLDLOCK) USING (VALUES (2)) AS source(id) ON target.id=source.id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id) VALUES (source.id);
SELECT id FROM dbo.items ORDER BY id
DELETE FROM dbo.t; INSERT dbo.t(id,n) VALUES (1,10),(2,20),(3,30)

MERGE dbo.t AS t USING (VALUES (1,11),(2,22),(4,44)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id
      WHEN MATCHED AND s.id=1 THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n
      WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE
      WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n)
      WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN UPDATE SET n=t.n+1
      OUTPUT $action, inserted.*, deleted.id, s.n AS source_n;
SELECT id,n FROM dbo.t ORDER BY id
DELETE FROM dbo.t; INSERT dbo.t(id,n) VALUES (1,10),(2,20),(3,30)
MERGE dbo.t AS t USING (VALUES (1,11),(1,12)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED AND s.n=12 THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n;
MERGE dbo.t AS t USING (VALUES (1,13),(1,14)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED AND s.n>100 THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n;
MERGE dbo.t AS t USING (VALUES (1,15),(1,16)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n OUTPUT $action, inserted.n; SELECT 1 AS after_error
MERGE dbo.t AS t USING (VALUES (1,17),(1,18)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED AND s.n=17 THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE;
SELECT id,n FROM dbo.t ORDER BY id
MERGE dbo.t AS t USING (VALUES (1),(1),(2)) AS s(id) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE OUTPUT $action, deleted.id; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS after_delete
SELECT id,n FROM dbo.t ORDER BY id
DELETE FROM dbo.t; INSERT dbo.t(id,n) VALUES (1,10),(2,20),(3,30)

BEGIN TRANSACTION; INSERT dbo.items VALUES (50); MERGE dbo.t AS t USING (VALUES (1,1),(1,2)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n; SELECT @@TRANCOUNT AS trancount, XACT_STATE() AS xact_state
SELECT @@TRANCOUNT AS trancount, XACT_STATE() AS xact_state, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.items WHERE id=50) AS prior_work

BEGIN TRANSACTION; INSERT dbo.items VALUES (51); MERGE dbo.t AS t USING (VALUES (1,-1),(9,9)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n); SELECT @@TRANCOUNT AS trancount, XACT_STATE() AS xact_state, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.items WHERE id=51) AS prior_work, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.t) AS target_rows
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
DELETE FROM dbo.t; INSERT dbo.t(id,n) VALUES (1,10),(2,20),(3,30)
MERGE dbo.t AS t USING (VALUES (1,-1)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS rowcount_after, @@ERROR AS error_after
MERGE dbo.t AS t USING (VALUES (1,CAST(NULL AS INT))) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n;
MERGE dbo.t AS t USING (VALUES (9,CAST(NULL AS INT))) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n);
MERGE dbo.t AS t USING (VALUES (8,1),(8,2)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n);
MERGE dbo.t AS t USING (VALUES (1,2)) AS s(id,k) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET id=s.k;
MERGE dbo.t AS t USING (VALUES (1,'too long')) AS s(id,note) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET note=s.note;
SELECT id,n,note FROM dbo.t ORDER BY id
MERGE dbo.blogs AS b USING (VALUES (5,N'x')) AS s(Id,Name) ON b.Id=s.Id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (Id,Name) VALUES (s.Id,s.Name);
MERGE dbo.blogs AS b USING (VALUES (1)) AS s(Id) ON 1=1 WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET Id=s.Id;
MERGE dbo.computed AS c USING (VALUES (1,2)) AS s(id,n) ON c.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET twice=s.n;
MERGE dbo.t AS t USING (VALUES (9,9)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id);
MERGE [dbo].[blogs] USING (VALUES (N'first', 0), (N'second', 1)) AS i ([Name], _Position) ON 1=0 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ([Name]) VALUES (i.[Name]) OUTPUT INSERTED.[Id], i._Position;
MERGE dbo.computed AS c USING (VALUES (1,2)) AS s(id,n) ON c.id=s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n) OUTPUT inserted.*;

CREATE TABLE dbo.defaults(id INT IDENTITY(1,1) CONSTRAINT PK_defaults PRIMARY KEY, n INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_defaults_n DEFAULT 7); MERGE dbo.defaults AS d USING (VALUES (1),(2)) AS s(k) ON 1=0 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT DEFAULT VALUES OUTPUT $action, inserted.*, s.k;
